objective: Preallocate ALTER TABLE result message buffers from the known operation count.

tasks.title: Preallocate ALTER TABLE messages
tasks.result: ALTER TABLE now reserves result-message capacity from operations.len(), with multi-operation coverage.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
cargo fmt was applied once, then the full sql_ddl test file was rerun against the final formatted state.
The change preserves ALTER operation execution order and final message joining semantics.
